cohort: 431 infants born in June-August 2017 were followed for 10 months during their first year of life.
finding: A total of 55 episodes of laboratory-confirmed influenza were diagnosed among 408 actively participating children, corresponding to an annual incidence rate of 135/1000 children, with acute otitis media developing as a complication in 46% and hospitalization in 2% of influenza cases.
